title: Trump ally Nigel Farage wins special election to return to UK parliament
summary: Nigel Farage, a Trump ally, won a special election to return to UK parliament after stepping down last month to trigger the vote. Farage branded the election as a fight against "the establishment," though he faces controversy surrounding his finances. His victory marks a significant political comeback for the prominent Brexit advocate.
content: Farage stepped down last month to trigger the vote, branding it a fight against "the establishment," amid controversy over his finances.

zh.title: 特朗普盟友奈杰尔·法拉奇赢得特别选举重返英国议会
zh.summary: 特朗普盟友奈杰尔·法拉奇赢得特别选举重返英国议会，他上月辞职以触发此次投票。法拉奇把选举称为对抗"建制派"的斗争，尽管他面临围绕其财务的争议。他的胜利标志着这位著名脱欧倡导者的重大政治复出。

title: China built robots that can do backflips – but can they make money?
summary: Chinese robotics company Unitree is preparing for an IPO that will test investor appetite for humanoid robots amid geopolitical tensions. The company's backflip-capable robots have yet to prove meaningful commercial viability in the market. The IPO outcome will indicate whether investors are willing to fund autonomous robotics despite uncertain profitability.
content: Unitree’s IPO will gauge investors’ appetite for a technology that has yet to prove its commercial viability amid intensifying geopolitical tensions.

zh.title: 中国制造的会翻筋斗的机器人——但它们能赚钱吗？
zh.summary: 中国机器人公司优树正准备进行首次公开募股，这将考验投资者在地缘政治紧张局势中对人形机器人的兴趣。该公司能做翻筋斗的机器人尚未证明在市场上具有有意义的商业可行性。首次公开募股的结果将表明投资者是否愿意资助自主机器人，尽管盈利能力不确定。

title: How a niche copper trade became a real-time gauge of Trump’s next tariff move
summary: The price spread between copper traded on different exchanges is increasingly being used by investors as an indicator of potential U.S. tariff movements. This niche market dynamic reflects heightened concerns about Trump's trade policy in a shifting geopolitical environment. The copper spread effectively functions as a real-time market gauge of tariff expectations.
content: The widening price of copper between two metals exchanges is offering investors a gauge of U.S. tariff risk.

zh.title: 一个利基铜贸易如何成为衡量特朗普下一步关税行动的实时指标
zh.summary: 在不同交易所交易的铜之间的价格差价越来越被投资者用作美国潜在关税行动的指标。这种利基市场动态反映了在地缘政治环境变化中对特朗普贸易政策的高度担忧。铜价差实际上发挥了关税预期的实时市场指标的作用。

title: Higher-rated corporate debt might not be the best trade. Goldman weighs in on credit quality
summary: With elevated real interest rates and increased AI-driven corporate debt issuance, investors are reconsidering their positions within higher-rated corporate credit markets. Goldman Sachs analysis suggests that investors may be underestimating credit quality risks in the current environment. The reassessment reflects broader portfolio strategy changes among institutional investors.
content: Amid higher real rates and an elevated AI-related supply, investors are reassessing positioning within corporate credit.

zh.title: 高评级企业债券可能不是最佳交易。高盛权衡信用质量
zh.summary: 随着实际利率上升和人工智能驱动的企业债务发行增加，投资者正在重新评估他们在高评级企业信用市场中的头寸。高盛分析表明，投资者可能低估了当前环境中的信用质量风险。这种重新评估反映了机构投资者更广泛的投资组合战略变化。

title: US says dozens of countries helped China dodge Trump's tariffs
summary: A new U.S. report accuses dozens of countries of facilitating Chinese tariff evasion by routing goods through nations with lower tariff rates. The finding reveals the challenges U.S. authorities face in enforcing tariffs on Chinese imports. The report underscores the complexity of global trade dynamics amid escalating trade tensions.
content: A new US report said China had moved goods through nations with lower tariffs to dodge higher levies.

zh.title: 美国表示数十个国家帮助中国规避特朗普关税
zh.summary: 一份新的美国报告指控数十个国家通过将商品转运到关税率较低的国家来便利中国关税规避。该发现揭示了美国当局在对中国进口商品实施关税方面面临的挑战。该报告强调了在贸易紧张升级的情况下全球贸易动态的复杂性。

title: U.S. to use economic tactics on Iran 'that have never been seen'; Navy works to relieve troubled carrier USS Abraham Lincoln
summary: The U.S. plans unprecedented economic isolation measures against Iran while maintaining a blockade in the Strait of Hormuz. This strategy represents a significant escalation in pressure tactics against the nation. The Navy is simultaneously addressing operational challenges with the USS Abraham Lincoln carrier.
content: "It will be a combination of economic isolation like ‌the world has ​never seen before, ​and ​the continued blockade in ‌the Strait of ​Hormuz," Bessent said.

zh.title: 美国对伊朗采取"前所未有"的经济战术；海军致力于缓解"林肯号"航母的困境
zh.summary: 美国计划对伊朗实施前所未有的经济孤立措施，同时在霍尔木兹海峡维持封锁。这一战略代表了对该国施压战术的重大升级。海军同时正在应对"林肯号"航母的运作挑战。

title: Stock futures are little changed after S&P 500 sets record above 7,800, heads for winning week: Live updates
summary: The S&P 500 reached a record high above 7,800 as markets headed for their third consecutive week of gains. Stock futures showed minimal movement following Thursday's rally. The Nasdaq Composite participated in the broader upward momentum.
content: Thursday's gain put the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite on pace for their third straight weekly advances.

zh.title: 标普500指数创纪录突破7800后股指期货基本持平，股市继续走高：实时更新
zh.summary: 标普500指数触及7800以上的纪录高位，市场实现三周连续上涨。周四涨势后股指期货基本保持不变。纳斯达克综合指数也参与了更广泛的上升势头。

title: Uber partners with China's Pony.ai for 2,000 robotaxis in Europe
summary: Uber partnered with Chinese autonomous vehicle company Pony.ai to deploy 2,000 robotaxis across Europe. The expansion reflects growing importance of fleet scale for viability in the autonomous taxi market. The collaboration brings Chinese technology into European ridesharing operations.
content: The rollout comes as robotaxi fleet sizes become increasingly critical for commercialization.

zh.title: 优步与中国Pony.ai合作在欧洲部署2000辆自动驾驶出租车
zh.summary: 优步与中国自动驾驶公司Pony.ai合作，在欧洲部署2000辆自动驾驶出租车。这一扩张反映了车队规模对自动驾驶出租车市场可行性的日益重要性。该合作将中国技术引入欧洲打车运营。

title: Reddit is joining the S&P 500 after months of speculation. Analysts have these concerns.
summary: Reddit gained inclusion in the S&P 500 after previous rejections, triggering an after-hours stock rally. The milestone represents validation of the social media platform's status among major market indexes. Analysts have expressed reservations about the company's long-term prospects.
content: After past snubs, social-media site Reddit has landed a spot on the S&P 500, sending shares on an after-hours rally Thursday.

zh.title: Reddit在数月推测后加入标准普尔500指数。分析师对此有这些担忧。
zh.summary: Reddit在多次被拒后获得纳入标准普尔500指数，引发了盘后股票飙升。这个里程碑代表了对这个社交媒体平台在主要市场指数中地位的认可。分析师对该公司的长期前景表示担忧。

title: From Apple to Ford: How Chinese tech is becoming harder for global companies to ignore
summary: Major global corporations including Apple and Ford are increasingly adopting Chinese technology due to improving capabilities and scale. The trend reflects China's growing technological competitiveness despite ongoing geopolitical tensions. Companies balance innovation benefits against potential risks from international trade dynamics.
content: Global companies are increasingly tapping Chinese technology for its growing capabilities and scale, even as geopolitical risks remain.

zh.title: 从苹果到福特：中国科技如何成为全球公司难以忽视的存在
zh.summary: 包括苹果和福特在内的主要全球企业因中国技术的能力不断提升和规模扩大而越来越多地采用。这一趋势反映了中国在持续地缘政治紧张局势中日益增强的技术竞争力。企业需要平衡创新收益与国际贸易动态带来的潜在风险。
